notes.conditions_split: Crops 02 and 04 put reagents above the arrow and solvent and temperature below. Crops 01 and 06 are two-step schemes that split by step (crop 01: NMP and r.t. 1 h above, NiBr2 diglyme, n-Bu2phen, Mn and r.t. 23 h below), so the rule holds for single-step schemes only.
notes.substrate_layout: Inline in crops 02, 04 and 05. Crop 03 shows the general alcohol and chlorosilane pair stacked, with the plus sign between them. Crop 01 places the chlorosilane 2a under the start of the arrow as a reagent, with no plus sign.
notes.show_plus_sign: Plus sign shown in crops 02, 04, 05 and 08. Crop 01 has none because 2a is a reagent under the arrow.
notes.yield_placement: under_product_label in crops 06 (under the product), 08, 09 and 10: yield and ee on the line under the label. Crop 04 has no product label and sets '92%, 18% ee' directly under the structure. Crop 07 writes 'label: yield' on the label line (7aa: 70%).
notes.yield_format: {value}% in crops 04, 06, 07, 08 and 09. Crop 10 writes '24 % Yield' on its own line under the label; the majority form is kept.
notes.yield_separator: ', ' between yield and ee in crops 04 and 08 ('92%, 18% ee', '70%, 89% ee'). Crop 07's colon sits between the label and a yield with no ee, so it is a label separator, not this one.
notes.reagent_text_color: Black in crops 01, 02 and 04 and in most of crop 06. Exceptions: the introduced reagent Mn in crop 06 is blue, and the light source (Blue LEDs) in crop 08 is blue. Black is kept as the majority colour.
notes.arrow_length_over_bond_length: Crops disagree widely: 3.3 (crop 09), 4.9 (01), 5.6 (04), 6.25 (06), 6.7 (02), 9.0 (03), 10.3 (07), 11.0 (08). The median of these eight, 6.5, is kept; 7.6 lies within one unit of crop 02 only.
notes.abbreviate_groups: Me is labelled on silicon (crop 01) and on aryl and alkyl ends (crop 07); the terminal CH3 of ethyl and methyl groups stays skeletal (crops 09 and 10). OMe is labelled in crops 07 and 08; crop 02 draws the methoxy group skeletally. TIPS and OEt are labelled in crop 04 but are not in the abbreviation table, so they cannot be listed.
notes.substrate_colors: Null. Crop 02 (Ma et al.) colours 1a slate and 2a dark red; crops 03, 06 and 07 (Oestreich et al.) colour the silyl fragment blue. No colour list is shared across papers.
notes.new_bond_color: Null. The blue new C-Si bond in crops 03, 06 and 07 comes from one paper (Oestreich et al.); crops 04 and 09 are all black.
